mapper.select: SELECT u.id as userId, u.type as userType, u.login_id as userLoginId, u.password as userPassword, u.fullname as userFullname, u.gender as userGender, u.birthday as userBirthday, u.mobile as userMobile, u.email as userEmail, u.address as userAddress, u.profile_img as userProfileImg, u.session_id as userSessionId, u.auto_login_limit as userAutoLoginLimit, u.wrong_password_count as userWrongPasswordCount, u.created_at as userCreatedAt, u.updated_at as userUpdatedAt, u.deleted_at as userDeletedAt, c.id as courseId, c.name as courseName, le.id as leId, le.completion_status as leCompletionStatus FROM user u LEFT JOIN learner_enrollment le ON u.id = le.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON c.id = sa.course_id LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON sa.user_id = sd.user_id WHERE le.id = #{leId} AND ( u.id = ${loginUserId} OR ( u.type = 'LEARNER' AND ( (sd.position = 'GENERAL_MANAGER') OR (sd.position IN ('COURSE_HEAD', 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR') AND sa.user_ID = #{loginUserId}) ) ) )

SELECT t.id AS testId, ts.id AS tsId, ts.submission_status AS tsSubmissionStatus, ts.score AS tsScore, ts.is_invalidated AS tsIsInvalidated FROM test t LEFT JOIN test_submission ts ON t.id = ts.test_id WHERE
t.course_id = #{enrolledCourseId} AND ts.learner_id = #{learnerId}

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, hs.id AS hsId, he.id AS heId, he.is_pass AS heIsPass FROM homework h LEFT JOIN homework_submission hs ON h.id = hs.homework_id LEFT JOIN homework_eval he ON hs.id = he.hs_id WHERE
h.course_id = #{enrolledCourseId} AND (hs.learner_id = #{learnerId} OR hs.learner_id is NULL)

SELECT p.id AS pId, pr.id AS prId, p.status AS pStatus, p.check_in AS pCheckIn, p.check_out AS pCheckOut, p.participation_date AS pParticipationDate, p.training_time AS pTrainingTime, pr.explanation AS prExplanation FROM participation p LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE p.learner_enrollment_id = #{leId}
ORDER BY participation_date DESC

SELECT p.id AS pId, pr.id AS prId, p.status AS pStatus, p.check_in AS pCheckIn, p.check_out AS pCheckOut, p.participation_date AS pParticipationDate, p.training_time AS pTrainingTime, pr.explanation AS prExplanation FROM participation p LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE p.learner_enrollment_id = #{leId}
ORDER BY participation_date DESC LIMIT #{pageParticipationReqDTO.offset}, #{pageParticipationReqDTO.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{leId} AND participation_date < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE employment_support SET employment_status = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.employmentStatus}, company_name = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.companyName}, company_phone = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.companyPhone}, company_address = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.companyAddress}, is_counseling_received = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.isCounselingReceived}, counseling_details = #{employmentSupportReqDTO.counselingDetails} WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{leId}
mapper.select: SELECT userId, userFullname, leId, leUserId, leCourseId, leCompletionStatus, coIsInProgress, coCourseHeadId, coInstructorId, coCourseHeadName, coInstructorName FROM ( SELECT ul.id AS userId, ul.fullname AS userFullname, le.id AS leId, le.user_id AS leUserId, le.course_id AS leCourseId, le.completion_status AS leCompletionStatus, co.is_in_progress AS coIsInProgress, cr.id AS coClassroomId, cr.name AS coClassroomName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'COURSE_HEAD' THEN sa.user_id END) AS coCourseHeadId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR' THEN sa.user_id END) AS coInstructorId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'COURSE_HEAD' THEN us.fullname END) AS coCourseHeadName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR' THEN us.fullname END) AS coInstructorName FROM user ul LEFT JOIN learner_enrollment le ON ul.id = le.user_id LEFT JOIN course co ON le.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON co.id = sa.course_id LEFT JOIN user us ON sa.user_id = us.id LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON us.id = sd.user_id LEFT JOIN classroom_allocation ca ON ca.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON cr.id = ca.classroom_id WHERE ul.type = 'LEARNER' GROUP BY ul.id, ul.fullname, le.id, le.user_id, le.course_id, le.completion_status, co.is_in_progress, cr.id, cr.name ) AS origin WHERE

SELECT id AS userId, type AS userType, login_id AS userLoginId, password AS userPassword, fullname AS userFullname, gender AS userGender, birthday AS userBirthday, mobile AS userMobile, email AS userEmail, address AS userAddress, profile_img AS userProfileImg, session_id AS userSessionId, auto_login_limit AS userAutoLoginLimit, wrong_password_count AS userWrongPasswordCount, created_at AS userCreatedAt, updated_at AS userUpdatedAt, deleted_at AS userDeletedAt FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT id AS esId, learner_enrollment_id AS esLearnerEnrollmentId, is_counseling_received AS esIsCounselingReceived, counseling_details AS esCounselingDetails, employment_status AS esEmploymentStatus, company_name AS esCompanyName, company_phone AS esCompanyPhone, company_address AS esCompanyAddress, created_at AS esCreatedAt, updated_at AS esUpdatedAt, deleted_at AS esDeletedAt FROM employment_support WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{leId}

SELECT pa.id AS partId, pa.learner_enrollment_id AS partLearnerEnrollmentId, pa.status AS partStatus, pa.check_in AS partCheckIn, pa.check_out AS partCheckOut, pa.training_time AS partTrainingTime, pa.participation_date AS partParticipationDate, pa.created_at AS partCreatedAt, pa.updated_at AS partUpdatedAt, pa.deleted_at AS partDeletedAt, pr.explanation AS partExplanation FROM participation pa LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON pr.participation_id = pa.id WHERE pa.learner_enrollment_id = #{leId}

SELECT pa.id AS partId, pa.learner_enrollment_id AS partLearnerEnrollmentId, pa.status AS partStatus, pa.check_in AS partCheckIn, pa.check_out AS partCheckOut, pa.training_time AS partTrainingTime, pa.participation_date AS partParticipationDate, pa.created_at AS partCreatedAt, pa.updated_at AS partUpdatedAt, pa.deleted_at AS partDeletedAt, pr.explanation AS partExplanation FROM participation pa LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON pr.participation_id = pa.id WHERE pa.id = #{pId}

SELECT ho.id AS hoId, ho.title AS hoTitle, ho.start_date AS hoStartDate, ho.end_date AS hoEndDate, ho.content AS hoContent, ho.course_id AS hoCourseId, ho.read_count AS hoReadCount, ho.instructor_id AS hoInstructorId, ho.created_at AS hoCreatedAt, ho.updated_at AS hoUpdatedAt, ho.deleted_at AS hoDeletedAt,
hs.id AS hsId, hs.homework_id AS hsHomeworkId, hs.title AS hsTitle, hs.content AS hsContent, hs.read_count AS hsReadCount, hs.learner_id AS hsLearnerId, hs.created_at AS hsCreatedAt, hs.updated_at AS hsUpdatedAt, hs.deleted_at AS hsDeletedAt,
he.id AS heId, he.hs_id AS heHsId, he.is_pass AS heIsPass, he.content AS heContent, he.read_count AS heReadCount, he.instructor_id AS heInstructorId, he.created_at AS heCreatedAt, he.updated_at AS heUpdatedAt, he.deleted_at AS heDeletedAt
FROM homework ho LEFT JOIN homework_submission hs ON ho.id = hs.homework_id LEFT JOIN homework_eval he ON hs.id = he.hs_id WHERE ho.course_id = #{leCourseId} AND hs.learner_id = #{leUserId}

SELECT te.id AS teId, te.instructor_id AS teInstructorId, te.course_id AS teCourseId, te.title AS teTitle, te.start_date AS teStartDate, te.end_date AS teEndDate, te.test_time AS teTestTime, te.total_score AS teTotalScore, te.created_at AS teCreatedAt, te.updated_at AS teUpdatedAt, te.deleted_at AS teDeletedAt,
ts.id AS tsId, ts.test_id AS tsTestId, ts.learner_id AS tsLearnerId, ts.submission_time AS tsSubmissionTime, ts.submission_status AS tsSubmissionStatus, ts.retry_count AS tsRetryCount, ts.is_invalidated AS tsIsInvalidated, ts.submission_reg_date AS tsSubmissionRegDate, ts.score AS tsScore, ts.created_at AS tsCreatedAt, ts.updated_at AS tsUpdatedAt, ts.deleted_at AS tsDeletedAt FROM test te LEFT JOIN test_submission ts ON te.id = ts.test_id WHERE te.course_id = #{leCourseId} AND ts.learner_id = #{leUserId}

SELECT co.id AS coId, co.is_in_progress AS coIsInProgress, co.name AS coName, co.number_of_learner AS coNumberOfLearner, co.start_date AS coStartDate, co.end_date AS coEndDate, co.total_hours AS coTotalHours, co.total_days AS coTotalDays, co.daily_hours AS coDailyHours, co.break_time AS coBreakTime, co.lesson_start_time AS coLessonStartTime, co.lesson_end_time AS coLessonEndTime, co.lunch_start_time AS coLunchStartTime, co.lunch_end_time AS coLunchEndTime, co.created_at AS coCreatedAt, co.updated_at AS coUpdatedAt, co.deleted_at AS coDeletedAt, cr.id AS crId, cr.name AS crName FROM course co LEFT JOIN classroom_allocation ca ON ca.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON cr.id = ca.classroom_id WHERE co.id = #{leCourseId}
SELECT sd.position FROM user u LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON sd.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{loginUserId}
